basics.name: Ryan Chen
basics.tagline: Software engineer who learns fast, adapts quickly, and loves a challenging problem.
basics.summary: I'm a Computer Science student at Northeastern, graduating in December 2026. I started programming because of video games, and that curiosity led to co-ops building API frameworks and data pipelines at Verisk and name-matching and search features at Babel Street. Outside of code, I'm usually learning a new board game, trying out a recipe, or out with friends.

experience.title: Software Engineer Co-op
highlights: Designed and developed Region of Origin classification feature to improve matching of multi-regional names, including SDK integration, testing, license gating, and packaging
Built a multilingual person-name data pipeline in Python by parsing a Wikidata dump, merging and deduplicating multilingual name records
Collaborated on an LLM-agent vendor vetting tool at a company hackathon, featuring an agentic workflow with sanctions screening, entity relationship graphing, and risk scoring
Led Java 25 migration across five repositories; surfaced Solr and OpenSearch Security Manager compatibility blockers that shaped the team's runtime roadmap
Improved API error-code accuracy on REST API endpoints and back-ported the fix across multiple release branches in both Elasticsearch and OpenSearch plugins

experience.title: Junior Software Developer Co-op
highlights: Designed and implemented a modular, reusable Secure Internal API framework — from proof of concept to deployment — standardizing token management and authentication across 10+ services
Contributed to the development of SFPublish, an internal API that facilitates data transfers from S3 to Snowflake, enabling ingestion of JSON-formatted files
Developed an automated API deployment script and migrated legacy scripts from shell to Python, improving maintainability and deployment speed by 30%
Built and maintained Snowpipes to automate ingestion of files from S3 into Snowflake for users, supporting a fully operational end-to-end data pipeline

experience.title: Senior Developer
highlights: Co-led development of a React/Tailwind frontend for NUMAC, Northeastern's student marketing consultancy, managing a 3-person junior dev team to build a client-facing project portfolio

Built React-based frontend for 3 Stones, a real-estate startup, implementing mobile application from high-fidelity mockups and landing page with waitlist functionality, serving as the primary user acquisition channel for pre-launch

experience.title: Project Manager Assistant
highlights: Collaborated in the design and development of a mobile application aimed at connecting 100+ patients with local healthcare providers, inspired by Zocdoc

projects.name: CodeStack
highlights: Implemented social networking features including follow/unfollow system with real-time updates via Socket.io, direct messaging with privacy settings, and inline follow buttons on user lists, reducing navigation time by 60%

Developed two-factor authentication with QR code integration and session timeout system with warning modals, while redesigning application UI with centralized CSS variable system to maintain consistent purple gradient theme across 15+ components

projects.name: Fakebook Crawler
highlights: Created a web crawler in Python, capable of navigating through secure HTTPS connections using SSL, handling session management, and parsing HTML to efficiently extract secret flags from a simulated social media site

projects.name: Hexagonal Reversi
highlights: Developed a feature-rich Java implementation of Reversi on a hexagonal grid, utilizing Swing for a graphical user interface (GUI) and engineering a text-based view; applied advanced design patterns including MVC architecture, observer pattern, strategy pattern, and adapter pattern, ensuring modularity and maintainability of the codebase
